guides.title: Huge Mistakes to Avoid — Early-Game Progression Audit — Tactical Dossier
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: Avoid the game-breaking blunders that ruin accounts! ⚠️ The ultimate cautionary guide to long-term success across the current KvK theater. Learn the catastrophic mistakes that set players behind—from burning rare resource tokens and expansion items outside of KvK, to mismanaging AP, wasting precious Gold Heads on gold key commanders, and draining your gem reserves on trap investments.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
# Major Mistakes Players Make across the current KvK theater

## Wasting Resource Tokens

One of the most common long-term mistakes is using resource tokens too early or without necessity. In the early game, resources can be gathered constantly, but during KVK these tokens become a critical war reserve.

Spending them casually outside of real emergencies often leaves players underprepared when large-scale fighting begins.

## Using Speedups at the Wrong Time

Speedups are one of the most valuable resources in the game, yet many players waste them on low-impact upgrades or events with weak rewards.

A major mistake is using speedups when there is no meaningful return. They should only be used in events that provide guaranteed value such as power-up rewards, training events, or structured milestone events.

Using speedups without reward structure is one of the fastest ways to fall behind in KVK preparation.

## Poor AP Management

Action Points are extremely valuable and should always be actively managed.

Many players make the mistake of sitting at full AP, which wastes regeneration over time. Others use AP inefficiently outside of events, losing large amounts of potential resources and progression value.

Proper AP cycling during high-reward events is essential for long-term efficiency.

## Wasting Expansion Items

25% and 50% expansion items are extremely rare, especially for free-to-play and low spend players.

These should almost never be used in normal gameplay. They are designed specifically for war scenarios where troop capacity directly impacts performance.

Using them outside of KVK or major battles is one of the most unnecessary resource losses in the game.

## Overinvesting in Early Research

Many players assume that fast research early game is required, but this often leads to inefficient speedup usage.

Speeding up tech too early reduces your ability to perform in KVK. Research becomes far more efficient when combined with buffs, titles, runes, and event timing during KVK periods.

Saving speedups and using them under proper conditions can drastically reduce total cost.

## Misunderstanding Alliance Value

A common misconception is that power alone determines value in top alliances.

In reality, leadership prioritizes consistency, activity, and contribution. Players who participate in events, join barb forts, communicate, and support the alliance are far more valuable than inactive high-power accounts.

Reliability is always more important than raw stats.

## Bad Gem Spending Habits

One of the most damaging mistakes is spending gems without long-term planning.

Many players waste gems on low-value items such as the Courier Station, resources, or speedups, which provide very little return compared to their cost.

Gems should also not be used on events that offer weak or inconsistent rewards.

Another major mistake is investing heavily in early-game commanders or systems without considering long-term KVK impact.

## Not Keeping a Gem Reserve

Many players fail to maintain a safe gem reserve, causing them to miss critical opportunities later.

A minimum gem reserve should always be preserved for key events, VIP progression, and essential commander investments.

Gems should never be allowed to drop to zero without a clear plan.

## Misusing Resources from Item Packs

Another common mistake is relying too heavily on resource packs instead of natural gathering.

Try to avoid unnecessarily using stored resource items, especially outside of emergency situations. These should be reserved for KVK efficiency, healing, and war demands.

## Overcommitting to Rallying or Garrisoning (F2P–Mid Spenders)

A major long-term mistake for free-to-play and mid spenders is investing heavily into rally or garrison roles too early.

This can slow down overall account development and put unnecessary strain on resources, often delaying long-term KVK readiness for both the player and the kingdom.

## Wasting Gold Heads on Low-Value Commanders

One of the biggest irreversible mistakes is using golden sculptures on gold key commanders.

For F2P and mid spend players, gold heads should only be saved for high-value legendary commanders that are relevant for KVK. Spending them on low-impact commanders severely limits long-term account strength.

barbs, they give rss per barb you hit, you get some reserve chest that give a decent amount of rss. (especially worth it as F2P)

events:

guides.title: Sunset Canyon
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: This guide was Made In Conjunction With Curly Gaming  Maximize your daily and weekly rewards across the current KvK theater with this strategic breakdown of Sunset Canyon. This guide outlines the optimal five-march formation—featuring front-line infantry tanks, back-line AOE damage dealers, and a strategic support buffer—to ensure your team dominates the battlefield. It provides clear tactical setups for both attack and defense, alongside essential progression tips such as rushing City Hall levels for march capacity and managing commander experience efficiently. Whether you are an F2P player or a spender, this blueprint offers the precise positioning and commander pairings needed to secure consistent victories and essential resources.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
REWARDS

Why should you put your time into Sunset Canyon?

•Sunset canyon gives gold keys, training speedups, and most importantly XP books daily and at the end of each week.

•You also get rewards for using your challenge attempts which consist of materials, keys, xp books and speedups.

COMMANDERS

Which commanders should you use for sunset? What should you look for?

2 TANKS:

•You want to ideally have 2 tanks. (Inf)

•Put them at the front of your attack and defense they can tank all the other marches.

•You want to have commanders with high counterattack stats and high health/ defense stats.

Tanky marches:

SPENDER:

CHARLES MARTEL, SUN TZU (can swap for AETHELFLED)

F2P:

BJORN, SUN TZU (strong for KVK too)

SPENDER & F2P:

CITY KEEPER, SCIPIO

SUN TZU, AETHELFLED

2 DAMAGE DOERS/AOES:

•2 main Damage Doers/ AOES behind the infantry tanks

•These need to be AOE so they hit all 3-5 marches.

•Need to provide massive amounts of skill damage

Damage Doer Marches:

SPENDER:

MINA, PELAGIUS (baibars exchangeable for PELAGIUS)

THUTMOSE, IMHOTEP (YSG Replace Imhotep when wheel comes around day 80)

F2P:

CAO CAO, BAIBARS (You get lots of Cao Cao heads early with keys)

BAIBARS, BELISARIUS

KUSUNOKI, TOMOE GOZEN (use TOMOE until tavern commanders unlock)

KUSUNOKI, IMHOTEP

HERMANN, KUSUNOKI

1 BUFF MARCH:

•1 buff march with a buffing 5 ally marches skill. This should be placed as far from the fight as possible so it can arrive late and buff the marches as its purpose.

Buff March:

F2P+ SPENDER:

JOAN OF ARC + MATILDA

(DO NOT UNLOCK 4TH SKILL ON MATILDA)

Non negotiable march for canyon this early in the game.

ATTACK:

How should you set up your Attacks?

•2 INF Tanks in the front to attract all enemy marches and tank all of the damage

•2 AOEs/Damage Doers in the back hiding behind the tanks. They need to arrive late so no marches focus on them.

•1 Buff March as far from the fight as possible

This march needs to arrive the latest and hopefully doesn’t attract any enemy marches focus, a maximum of 1 enemy march can be attracted. Anything more and you’re doing it wrong!

DEFENSE:

2 strategies:

Strategy 1:

Set it up like an attack all marches in a square, tanks front line, damage doers back line, and buffer march far back right hugging the formed square:

Strategy 2:

Put your strongest Tank March on the far right. (For me City Keeper, Scipio) And put your other 4 marches in a square on the other side of the map as before. (Tank front, damage doer front, damage doer back right of square, buffer on the corner of map)

The goal is here is to force the other player to focus your Tank March separated from the rest, so the tank can take all the damage while all your other marches across the map run in and get easy AOE damage and Buffs.

EXTRA INFO:

These are things that will help you with your sunset capabilities early of.

•Rush city halls, 17 first for the 4th March, 22 second for the 5th March (get here as quick as possible)

•Do guardians to try and get your commander XPs up

•Use the reset event to reset commanders you need XP back on.

/•Feel free to use GH and SH on commanders you will use for KVK 1, (GHs only for High spenders, the legendary commanders can be swapped later on for meta commanders)

•Don’t feel a need to change talent trees for only sunset. It won’t help much. Unless it’s someone like City Keeper who is a SUNSET ONLY commander.

•You CAN craft lower level equipments. Because they dismantle for 100% gear back. But don’t feel the need to.

guides.title: VIP Leveling Milestones
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: Unlock permanent daily rewards, claim up to 3 free Universal Legendary Sculptures per day, and build a massive account buff foundation! 👑 The ultimate VIP Leveling & Progression Priorities Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide breaks down the critical VIP milestones and gem investment strategies every player must know. Learn why rushing VIP 6 is essential on day one, how VIP 10, 12, and 14 transform your daily gold head income, and why every gem should be funneled directly into VIP points during "More Than Gems" events. Discover essential habits for leveraging alliance gift chests, utilizing the VIP shop for discounted resources, and avoiding gem-spending traps on off-event days!
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

- VIP Progression Priority: VIP levels provide permanent account-wide buffs, daily free rewards, and passive Legendary Universal Sculptures that compound your overall account growth over time.

- VIP 6 Baseline: Hitting VIP 6 as early as possible is mandatory because it permanently unlocks the second building queue, eliminating the need to spend 150 gems for temporary builder hire items.

- Gem Investment Rule: As an F2P or low-spending player, every single free gem you earn should be saved and funneled directly into VIP points until you reach your targeted milestones.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

- VIP 10 Milestone: VIP 10 is the first major endgame milestone for F2P players because it awards 1 free Legendary Universal Sculpture every single day upon logging in.

- VIP 12 Milestone: VIP 12 doubles your daily passive sculpture income by granting 2 Legendary Universal Sculptures per day, drastically speeding up your commander expertise timelines.

- VIP 14 Milestone: VIP 14 is the ultimate target for competitive players, delivering 3 Legendary Universal Sculptures daily alongside massive troop attack and health stat bonuses.

- Daily VIP Points: Login daily to maintain your VIP streak and collect escalating free daily VIP points from the login chest, which speeds up your path between major milestone tiers.

- Alliance Gift Chests: Staying in a top-tier spender alliance grants massive amounts of VIP points from open alliance gift chests, saving you tens of thousands of gems.

- Gem Hoarding Strategy: Never buy individual speedups or resources with gems from the shop; keep your gem stash strictly dedicated to VIP point pushes during key events.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- More Than Gems Event: Always save your gem stashes for the "More Than Gems" event to dump 7,000 or 25,000 gems per day into VIP to gain extra free Legendary Sculptures while leveling.

- VIP Shop Discounts: Once key VIP levels are unlocked, utilize the weekly VIP Shop to purchase highly discounted Action Point potions and speedups using excess food or wood.

- Alliance Help Speed: Higher VIP levels increase your base building and research speed buffs, allowing your account to gain far more value out of every alliance help click.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Buying VIP Points Outside Events: Avoid spending large amounts of gems on VIP points outside of the "More Than Gems" event, as you lose out on bonus milestone sculptures.

- Stopping at VIP 7–9: Do not stall your gem investment at VIP 7, 8, or 9; push through to VIP 10 immediately to start accumulating passive daily gold heads.

- Distracting Gem Purchases: Never spend gems on targeted equipment packs or random event spins before reaching at least VIP 10 or VIP 12.

guides.summary: Valheon Sovereign tactical dossier for 🏯 Hidden Lotus F2P event (Part 1 : Day 1- 6 ). Covers quantitative mechanics, ROI breakpoints, and live execution protocols integrated with Foundation & Tech Progression Suite.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
# 🏯 Hidden Lotus F2P event

Hidden Lotus F2P event

DISCLAIMER: The hidden Lotus skin is recommended for spenders or experienced F2P players, any new players or not very experienced should rather focus on upgrading your account the best way possible.

Short info:

It is not recommended to aim for specific power gains per day, as this can negatively impact the account in the long term. Free-to-play progression always carries a level of risk, since a single mistake can significantly set back overall progress. This event guide is designed to provide all the necessary information and priorities needed to efficiently work toward the final goal of 1.5 million power.

Notes to be aware of:

This section provides a brief overview of the Hidden Lotus event and the activities taking place in the meantime. These are the key elements and mechanics that will be referenced throughout the guide.

- The event takes 7 days

- Commander reset event 6-7 days available

- Gold keys only give Cao Cao the first 8 days

- 5% cav attack city skin

- 1,5m power goal

Power distribution overview:

Power distribution is a key factor in maximizing efficiency and getting the most value while minimizing unnecessary resource usage when aiming for these goals. The recommended values are based on precise calculations and extensive testing. Try to avoid exceeding the maximum allocated power for each category.

- Buildings power: 425k-525k

- Technology power: 200k-275k

- Troop power: 200k-275k

- Commander power: 500k-600k

Optimizing events and rewards:

As F2P we don’t want to spend any gems on speedups, which is why we have to optimize the events and rewards we get while the lotus event is up and running.

Always use your action point bar, the barbarians can end up being the most valuable sources of resource and speedup income.

Use path of vengeance to rush through great rewards, go until day 6 or 7 by only investing into the 5 commanders you use in your lineup to maximize profits from the event. When it’s close to the last minutes of either commander reset or the hidden lotus event, then reset every commander from the lineup and spread all the exp between all commanders that you have, each commander at lvl 20 can give 30k power alone without skills on them.

Free ways to increase power:

Path of vengeance: path of vengeance is one of the biggest gifts for F2P and low spenders, it provides: exp, sculptures, keys and gems.

Path of vengeance reward rates:

- 2%+ exp gain per level.

- 50% sculpture chance per level.

20 gems per 5 levels.

Expedition rewards are also a huge income in gaining speedups and resources, do it daily and actively to try and always maximize the income.

commander reset: this event will be a major part of you saving a lot of speedups and most likely many gems, you can reset all commanders after reaching 1,5m power and collecting the lotus skin. (it is important to look out for how long the event is active in your kingdom)

How to hit 1,5m:

Focus on doing events and gaining as many rewards as possible. Try to stay in top 1 alliance:

Hoard all speedups and resource tokens as a lifesaver, 100% you will use speedups, but rather use them on day 6 or 7 to optimize all the power from not spending a single speedup.

Commander power is the key to hitting 1,5m as a F2P and that is why you should spend the most of your time leveling up in path of vengeance for many sculptures, exp and gold keys.

VIP 6 for 2nd building queue to always be building and gaining power from it. Meanwhile research and training should always be occupied as well.

Mistakes to avoid:

- Not optimizing all events and reward opportunities possible.

using speedups the first few days because you think you are in a rush. This can hurt your account tremendously if you don’t just save them until the last 2 days of the event.

setting power goals per day, this is a huge mistake people make even when this event is not around, the main point of your account is not power, but it is the tactical decisions and fighting IQ. you need to optimize every way possible.

not resetting all commanders when hitting 1,5m and claiming the lotus skin, this event is made for F2P players to actually not hurt their account but rather hit the goal and be able to repair a lot of the power rushing.

# 1️⃣ Day 1

# Lotus Guide – Day 1 (Target: 308K Power)

## Building Priorities

Upgrade your buildings to the following levels:

- City Hall: 12

- Academy: 11

- Alliance Center: 11

- Tavern: 11

- Wall: 11

- Storehouse: 11

- Stable: 10

- Main Lumbermill: 10

- Hospital: 10

- Archery Range: 9

- Main Gold Mine: 8

- Barracks: 7

- Main Farm: 7

- Hospital: 7

- Siege Workshop: 6

- 3× Farms: 6

- 3× Lumbermills: 6

- Hospital: 6

- 2× Quarries: 5

- Watchtower: 4

- Castle: 1

### Resource Buildings

- Quarry: 12

- 2× Quarries: 5

- Gold Mine: 8

- Farm: 7

- 3× Farms: 6

- Lumbermill: 10

- 3× Lumbermills: 6

## Research Priorities

Prioritize economy research first, then complete the essential military upgrades.

### Economy

- Irrigation: 5

- Handsaw: 5

- Sickle: 5

- Masonry: 5

- Handaxe: 5

- Writing: 3

- Chisel: 2

- Metalworking: 2

- Quarrying: 1

- Metallurgy: 1

### Military

- Iron Working: 3

- Horsemanship: 3

- Flaming Projectile: 3

- Military Discipline: 1

- Swordsman: 1

- Bowman: 1

- Light Cavalry: 1

- Tracking: 1

## Troop Training

### While Online

- Train T1 troops only.

- Their short training time makes them the most efficient option for early Lotus progression.

### Before Going Offline

- Queue T2 troops.

- Use longer inactive periods to maximize training uptime.

## Commander Strategy

Commander Power is one of the most important factors in Lotus.

### Leveling

Upgrade commanders evenly rather than focusing on a few.

Example:

- Level all Green and Blue commanders to 10.

- Then raise them all to 15.

- Continue progressing them together.

### Gold Keys

- Unlock every commander possible from Gold Keys.

- Each new commander contributes additional Commander Power.

- Note: gold commanders available while doing lotus guide: Cao Cao.

### Commander Resets

- Do not hesitate to invest experience early.

- After receiving the Lotus skin, you can reset commanders and recover those resources.

Prioritize broad commander progression. Commander Power is often the difference between winning and losing Lotus.

## Day 1 Goal

Target Power: 308,000+

Following these building, research, troop, and commander priorities will keep you on track for optimal Lotus progression and the best chance of securing Lotus rewards.

🏯 Hidden Lotus F2P event

Hidden Lotus F2P event

DISCLAIMER: The hidden Lotus skin is recommended for spenders or experienced F2P players, any new players or not very experienced should rather focus on upgrading your account the best way possible.

Short info:

It is not recommended to aim for specific power gains per day, as this can negatively impact the account in the long term. Free-to-play progression always carries a level of risk, since a single mistake can significantly set back overall progress. This event guide is designed to provide all the necessary information and priorities needed to efficiently work toward the final goal of 1.5 million power.

Notes to be aware of:

This section provides a brief overview of the Hidden Lotus event and the activities taking place in the meantime. These are the key elements and mechanics that will be referenced throughout the guide.

  • The event takes 7 days
  • Commander reset event 6-7 days available
  • Gold keys only give Cao Cao the first 8 days
  • 5% cav attack city skin
  • 1,5m power goal

Power distribution overview:

Power distribution is a key factor in maximizing efficiency and getting the most value while minimizing unnecessary resource usage when aiming for these goals. The recommended values are based on precise calculations and extensive testing. Try to avoid exceeding the maximum allocated power for each category.

  • Buildings power: 425k-525k
  • Technology power: 200k-275k
  • Troop power: 200k-275k
  • Commander power: 500k-600k

Optimizing events and rewards:

As F2P we don’t want to spend any gems on speedups, which is why we have to optimize the events and rewards we get while the lotus event is up and running.

Always use your action point bar, the barbarians can end up being the most valuable sources of resource and speedup income.

Use path of vengeance to rush through great rewards, go until day 6 or 7 by only investing into the 5 commanders you use in your lineup to maximize profits from the event. When it’s close to the last minutes of either commander reset or the hidden lotus event, then reset every commander from the lineup and spread all the exp between all commanders that you have, each commander at lvl 20 can give 30k power alone without skills on them.

Free ways to increase power:

Path of vengeance: path of vengeance is one of the biggest gifts for F2P and low spenders, it provides: exp, sculptures, keys and gems.

Path of vengeance reward rates:

  • 2%+ exp gain per level.
  • 50% sculpture chance per level.

20 gems per 5 levels.

Expedition rewards are also a huge income in gaining speedups and resources, do it daily and actively to try and always maximize the income.

commander reset: this event will be a major part of you saving a lot of speedups and most likely many gems, you can reset all commanders after reaching 1,5m power and collecting the lotus skin. (it is important to look out for how long the event is active in your kingdom)

How to hit 1,5m:

Focus on doing events and gaining as many rewards as possible. Try to stay in top 1 alliance:

Hoard all speedups and resource tokens as a lifesaver, 100% you will use speedups, but rather use them on day 6 or 7 to optimize all the power from not spending a single speedup.

Commander power is the key to hitting 1,5m as a F2P and that is why you should spend the most of your time leveling up in path of vengeance for many sculptures, exp and gold keys.

VIP 6 for 2nd building queue to always be building and gaining power from it. Meanwhile research and training should always be occupied as well.

Mistakes to avoid:

  • Not optimizing all events and reward opportunities possible.

using speedups the first few days because you think you are in a rush. This can hurt your account tremendously if you don’t just save them until the last 2 days of the event.

setting power goals per day, this is a huge mistake people make even when this event is not around, the main point of your account is not power, but it is the tactical decisions and fighting IQ. you need to optimize every way possible.

not resetting all commanders when hitting 1,5m and claiming the lotus skin, this event is made for F2P players to actually not hurt their account but rather hit the goal and be able to repair a lot of the power rushing.

- Scale Armor: 3

- Enhanced Axle: 3

- Pathfinding: 2

- Spearman: 1

- Composite Bowman: 1

### Economy

No additional economy research is recommended.

## Troop Training

### While Online

- Train T1 troops only.

- T1 troops continue to provide the best Lotus power efficiency.

### Before Going Offline

- Queue T2 troops.

- Ensure training buildings remain active during downtime.

## Commander Strategy

Commander Power remains one of the most important factors in Lotus rankings.

### Leveling

Upgrade commanders evenly rather than focusing heavily on a few.

Example:

- Level all Green and Blue commanders to 10.

- Then raise them all to 15.

- Continue progressing them together.

### Gold Keys

- Unlock every commander possible from Gold Keys.

- Every new commander contributes additional Commander Power.

### Commander Resets

- Invest experience freely throughout Lotus.

- After obtaining the Lotus skin, commanders can be reset to recover invested resources.

At this stage of Lotus, Commander Power can often be the deciding factor between reward brackets. Continue broad commander development alongside your building upgrades.

## Day 7 Goal

Target Power: 1,500,000+

The final stretch focuses on efficient power gains through Hospital upgrades, Gold Mine development, continuous troop production, and steady Commander Power growth. Stay consistent to maximize your Lotus placement and secure the best possible rewards.

# ➕ Extra power source

# Extra Sources of Power and Efficiency

These tips can easily make the difference between missing and obtaining the Hidden Lotus skin. Most players focus only on buildings and research, but the following methods provide thousands of extra power over the course of the event.

## Explore Every Village and Cave

- Keep scouts moving at all times.

- Tribal Villages provide:

- Resources

- Speedups

- Commander EXP

- Resource tokens

- Economic boosts

- Mysterious Caves provide:

- Gems

- Speedups

- Tomes of Knowledge

- Resource packs

Many players underestimate exploration. The rewards from full map exploration can save hours of speedups.

## Kill Barbarians Constantly

- Spend all available Action Points.

- Chain barbarians whenever possible.

- Prioritize barbarians while your queues are running.

Benefits include:

- Commander EXP

- Resource packs

- Speedups

- Gems

- Event progress

Commander Power is one of the easiest power sources to overlook.

## Level Every Commander

Don't focus only on your main commanders.

Instead:

- Level all Green commanders evenly.

- Then level Blue commanders.

- Continue pushing commanders together.

Example:

- All Green → Level 10

- All Blue → Level 10

- All Green → Level 15

- All Blue → Level 15

The Lotus challenge rewards total Commander Power, not just strong commanders.

## Use Tomes of Knowledge Efficiently

- Don't let Tomes sit unused.

- Use them to hit important commander milestones.

- Prioritize commanders that are closest to their next level bracket.

Even a few levels across multiple commanders can provide a surprising amount of power.

## Never Let Queues Sit Idle

Before logging off, check that you have:

- A building upgrade running.

- Research in progress.

- Troops training.

- Scouts exploring.

Five minutes of inactivity isn't a problem. Several hours is often the difference between success and failure.

## Abuse Alliance Help

Always request alliance help immediately.

Alliance help reduces:

- Building times

- Research times

- Healing times

An active alliance can save several hours every day.

## Participate in Every Event

Even minor events matter.

Look for:

- Training events

- Barbarian events

- Gathering events

- Alliance events

- Daily objectives

Rewards often include:

- Speedups

- Resource tokens

- Gems

- Action Point recovery

## Gather Resources Before You Need Them

Do not wait until you run out.

Keep marches gathering whenever possible.

Priority:

- Food

- Wood

- Stone

- Gold

As your upgrades become more expensive, start prioritizing Gold earlier.

Resource shortages are one of the biggest reasons players stall around 1.2–1.4M power.

## Use a Farm Account

If you have the time:

- Create a secondary account in the same kingdom.

- Focus entirely on gathering resources.

- Transfer resources to your main account when needed.

Even a basic farm account can prevent progression bottlenecks.

## Save Speedups for the Final Push

Avoid using every speedup immediately.

Use them strategically:

- City Hall requirements

- Academy upgrades

- Important research

- Final Day 7 push

Players who save speedups almost always have a smoother finish than those who spend everything early.

## Complete Daily Objectives

Never skip daily tasks.

They provide:

- Resources

- Speedups

- Commander EXP

- Action Point recovery

- Gems

These rewards add up significantly over seven days.

## Use All Free Chests

Claim every free chest available.

Check regularly for:

- VIP Chests

- Tavern rewards

- Alliance gifts

- Event claimables

- Daily login rewards

Many players forget these and lose out on free progression.

## Upgrade Hospitals for Efficient Power

Hospitals provide excellent power relative to their cost.

If you're slightly behind pace:

- Hospital upgrades are often one of the fastest ways to gain extra power.

- This becomes especially effective during Days 5–7.

## Push Research Before Logging Off

Longer research timers are ideal overnight.

Before going offline:

- Start your longest available research.

- Queue T2 troop training.

- Begin a longer building upgrade.

This maximizes progress while you're away.

## Don't Panic if You're Behind

If you're short on power near the end:

Prioritize:

- Commander levels

- Hospital upgrades

- Troop training

- Short research upgrades

- Finishing partially completed buildings

Small gains from multiple sources often bridge the final 50,000–100,000 power needed for the Lotus skin.

guides.content_markdown:
BEST VALUE MICRO-TRANSACTIONS GUIDE

## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

* The Gem Benchmark Standard: Every in-game purchase is measured against standard Gem-to-USD conversion rates (Base Shop: $1 USD = ~200 Gems). Micro-transactions giving 1,000+ total Gem Equivalent Value per $1 spent represent elite ROI.

* Non-Farmable Item Priority: True value comes from non-farmable assets—specifically Universal Legendary Sculptures (Gold Heads), VIP Points, Blueprint Chests, and Legendary Materials—rather than basic resources or standard speedups.

VALUE-PER-DOLLAR RANKING TIER LIST

Rank / Bundle Name

Price (USD)

Total Gem-Equivalent Value

ROI Multiplier

Core Rewards & Recommendation

1. Growth Fund

$14.99

~81,000 Gems

~27x Value

#1 Absolute Priority. Yields 81k total gems as City Hall levels up. Single highest gem-per-dollar return in the game.

2. Writer of History

$4.99

~10,000 Gems

~10x Value

S-Tier Pop-up. Triggers upon unlocking any new Legendary Commander. Delivers 10 Universal Gold Heads + Gems + VIP Points.

3. 30-Day Gem Supply

$9.99 ($4.99 first buy)

~21,700 Gems

~10x–20x Value

S-Tier Subscription. Yields 650 gems daily (19.5k total) + 2.2k instant gems. The foundational engine for VIP 12/14 pushes.

4. Vanquisher Bundle

$4.99

~11,200 Gems

~11x Value

S-Tier Equipment Pop-up. Triggers when crafting your first Legendary Blueprint. Grants Legendary Equipment Chests, Gems, and Speedups.

5. Lucerne Scrolls ($4.99)

$4.99

~18,000–20,000 Gems

~8x–10x Value

A-Tier Seasonal Pass. Gives Gold Heads, Blueprint Choice Chests, Gems, and VIP Points over 8 weeks.

6. Daily Special Offer ($1)

$0.99

~1,500 Gems

~7x Value

A-Tier Targeted Buy. Purchasing strictly the $0.99 chest daily gives commander sculptures (like Cao Cao/Martel) + AP at high efficiency.

7. 7-Day Material Supply

$4.99

~5,250 Gems

~5x Value

B-Tier Gear Booster. Provides daily choices of Legendary Equipment Materials and Gems.

STRATEGIC PURCHASING & EVENT TIMING

* Recharge Event Optimization: Reserve non-urgent purchases (such as Gem Supply renewals or 7-Day Material Supplies) for official 5-Day Recharge Events. Reaching the 2,500-gem daily recharge milestone yields 30+ extra Universal Legendary Sculptures.

* The "Gold Head Reserve" Rule: Always keep $5 USD available in reserve for unexpected Writer of Historypop-up triggers. The 1-hour purchase timer means missing it permanently forfeits 10 Gold Heads at the best rate in the game.

* First-Purchase Double Gem Reset: Standard double-gem top-up bonuses (e.g., $99.99 for 50,000 gems) offer roughly ~2x value ($1 = 500 gems). This is vastly inferior to the Growth Fund or Gem Supply and should only be touched by high spenders during MTG events.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

* Buying Full Daily Chest Bundles ($1 + $2 + $5): The value drops sharply beyond the $0.99 chest. Buying all 3 daily chests costs $8/day ($240/month) for diminishing returns compared to targeted event bundles.

* Purchasing Standard "Super Value" Bundles at $5 Tier: Standard rotating bundles (e.g., King's Coronation or Call of the Ancients) offer poor baseline value at their $4.99 tier unless pushed to higher purchase levels during war emergencies.

* Letting Writer of History Timers Expire: Opening a Golden Key or unlocking an event commander when your budget is empty wastes a Writer of History trigger. Hold off on summoning new legendary commanders until you have $5 ready.

guides.title: Equip & Armament Spending Value — Tactical Dossier
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: * Non-Farmable Asset Metric: Evaluate gear packs based on their yield of Iconic Crystals, Legendary Blueprint Choice Chests, Legendary Inscription Inscription Transmutation Scrolls, and Material Choice Chests—not raw resources or basic speedups.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
CORE MECHANICS & VALUE FRAMEWORK

* The Power Multiplier Shift: In endgame Rise of Kingdoms, Equipment and Armaments determine open-field trade ratios far more than raw troop count or account power.

* Non-Farmable Asset Metric: Evaluate gear packs based on their yield of Iconic Crystals, Legendary Blueprint Choice Chests, Legendary Inscription Inscription Transmutation Scrolls, and Material Choice Chests—not raw resources or basic speedups.

* Gacha vs. Guaranteed Value: Armament packs (Inscribed Pegs/Inscriptions) operate on RNG base rolls, whereas Equipment packs yield fixed, deterministic material progress.

EQUIPMENT & ARMAMENT CASH PACK TIER LIST

Pack / Purchase Source

Price (USD)

Core Gear Contents

ROI Multiplier

Recommendation & Verdict

Vanquisher (Pop-Up)

$4.99

Material Choice Chests, Gems, Blueprint Chests

12x Value

S-Tier (Must Buy): Triggers upon crafting your 1st Legendary blueprint. Best dollar-to-material pop-up.

Hammer of the Sun King / Esmeralda

$4.99 – $50+

Choice Legendary Blueprints, Material Pickers

10x Value

S-Tier (Event): High-yield targeted blueprint events. Essential for acquiring meta set pieces (e.g., Hope Cloak, Seth's).

7-Day Material Supply

$4.99

Daily Legendary Material Chests + Gems

8x Value

A-Tier (Weekly): Continuous baseline material drip for low-to-mid spenders.

Armament Supply / Inscription Packs

$4.99 – $99.99

Inscribed Pegs, Inscription Transmutation Scrolls

5x–7x Value

B-Tier (Situational): High RNG risk. Only spend after securing core Legendary equipment sets.

Standard "Forge Master" Bundles

$4.99 – $99.99

Raw Materials, Blueprints, Speedups

3x Value

C-Tier (Avoid): Heavily diluted with filler resources; buy event-based gear packs instead.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & SPENDING ROUTINE

* The "Full Set First" Rule: Complete 1 full Legendary equipment setup (6 slots with active iconic stats) for your primary march before spending a single dollar on Armament or Inscription packs. Guaranteed gear stats outweigh RNG armament rolls.

* Recharge Event Alignment: Save all equipment purchases (including 7-Day Material Supplies and event spins) for 5-Day Recharge Events to stack extra Universal Gold Heads and Iconic materials.

* Armament Transmutation Protocol: Focus paid armament investment on acquiring Transmutation Scrolls to reroll stats on high-tier 3-attribute/4-attribute armaments rather than buying raw random armament chests.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

* Iconic Crystal Priority: Always secure Iconic Crystals during seasonal events or specialized pop-ups. Upgrading a Legendary weapon/armor slot to Iconic Tier 1/2 adds base Military Tech attack/defense stats directly to your march.

* Refining vs. Crafting New Gear: Avoid spending money crafting duplicate Legendary items for a secondary march until your main march's gear is fully refined and iconic-upgraded.

* Lucerne Scrolls Integration: The $4.99 Lucerne Scrolls pass remains one of the cheapest secondary sources for Legendary Equipment Choice Blueprints alongside equipment materials.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

* Chasing Armament Inscriptions Early: Never spend heavily on Armament/Inscription bundles if your main commander march is still wearing Epic (Purple) gear. Armament bonuses scale off base equipment stats.

* Crafting Off-Meta Gold Gear: Avoid spending cash or materials on low-impact Legendary items (e.g., standard gold accessories with weak passive stats); save materials exclusively for meta sets (like Eternal Empire or Leadership sets).

* Buying Standard Store Forge Bundles: Never buy non-event $4.99 Forge Master bundles outside active events; their material-per-dollar ratio is severely diluted compared to Esmeralda or Hammer events.

From City Hall milestones (Dare to Be Different / One Step Ahead) to Academy upgrades, unit tier promotions, and commander expertise unlocks, see the exact trigger conditions, costs, gems, and materials for every limited-time offer.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence

guides.content_markdown:
## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

* Season Structure: Lucerne Scrolls runs in 8-week (approx. 56-day) seasons featuring 80 progression levels. Leveling up requires Clues, earned by completing Daily, Weekly, and Season Challenges.

* The Reward Tiers:

* Ancestor’s Legacy: Free tier accessible to all players.

AppGamer

* Treasure Hunter ($4.99 USD): Unlocks the Divine Inheritance paid reward track.

AppGamer

* Archaeologist ($19.99 USD): Unlocks the paid track, gives an instant +10 level boost, and grants a +50% bonus to weekly challenge clues.

* Crucial Level 50 & 80 Milestones: Hitting Level 50 awards the primary seasonal Legendary Equipment Blueprint Choice Chest. Levels 51–80 offer extra bonus chests containing speedups, resources, and materials.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

* Weekly Challenge Roll-Over: Weekly challenges unlock in batches every 7 days, but past weeks do not disappear. If you miss a week due to real-life commitments or KvK war, you can catch up on uncompleted weekly tasks anytime before the season ends.

* Daily Clue Cap: Complete all 5 Daily Objectives to secure maximum passive Clues. Over an 8-week season, consistent daily completion covers nearly half the levels required to max the pass.

* Task Rerolling Protocol: Reroll high-cost weekly tasks (e.g., "Train 20,000 T5 Troops" or "Spend 50,000 Gems") using your free weekly refreshes to get easily doable PvE objectives like barbarian kills or resource gathering.

Purchase Tier

Price

ROI / Value Analysis

Who Should Buy?

Free Tier (Ancestor's)

$0.00

All F2P accounts.

Treasure Hunter

S-Tier Value (~20x return): Yields Legendary Blueprints, 6+ Gold Heads, 5,000 VIP, 2,300+ Gems, and +50% Army Expansions.

Active players who log in daily and complete weekly tasks.

Archaeologist

$19.99

Situational Value: Grants +10 instant levels and +50% weekly clues.

Casual spenders low on time or pushing level 80 for extra chest spam.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

* The "Buy at Level 50" Strategy: If you are unsure whether you will complete the pass, remain F2P until week 6 or 7. Once your progress naturally reaches Level 50, purchase the $4.99 Treasure Hunter pass to instantly claim all retroactively unlocked paid rewards.

* Event Quest Synchronization: Align Lucerne challenge completion with active events (e.g., complete "Use 30 Days of Speedups" during Game of Power or Mightiest Governor).

* Equipment Progression Engine: The $4.99 pass is the cheapest consistent source for top-tier Legendary Equipment Blueprints (like Hope Cloak, Seth's Brutality, or Karuak's Humility blueprints).

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

* Buying Archaeologist Late in the Season: Avoid purchasing the $19.99 Archaeologist pack in the final week just to catch up; the +50% weekly clue bonus applies retroactively, but buying $4.99 + grinding is significantly more cost-effective.

* Ignoring Daily Tasks: Skipping daily tasks forces you to rely entirely on weekly challenges, leaving you short of Level 50 unless you purchase the $19.99 tier.

* Spending Gems to Buy Levels: Never spend raw gems directly in the Lucerne menu to unlock missed levels; gem conversions here are extremely inefficient compared to Wheel of Fortune or MTG.

CORE MECHANICS & COST FORMULA

* Passport Page Definition: Passport Pages are the required consumption currency used to relocate your city across different kingdoms.

* Acquisition Methods:

* Free-to-Play (Individual Silver): Purchased in the Alliance Shop for 600,000 Individual Alliance Creditsper page. Officers spend 100,000 Alliance Credits from stock to stock them.

STRATEGIC WAYS TO REDUCE PASSPORT COSTS

* Hospital Filling Strategy: Intentionally fill your Hospitals to max capacity with high-tier troops (T4/T5) before checking migration requirements. Troops residing inside the hospital do not count toward your active displayed power.

* De-swarming Siege Units: Delete/disband unnecessary siege engines (especially T1 or surplus T4 siege). Siege adds zero open-field value but inflates your power bracket artificially.

* Spreading "New World" Purchases: Buy the cheap $4.99 tier of the New World Bundle once every month as it resets, accumulating pages over time without touching higher cash tiers.

* Alliance Credit Farming: Maximize daily tech donations, alliance help clicks, and flag building/demolishing cycles to generate at least 100,000+ Individual Credits daily.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

* Exceeding Resource Caps: Migrating requires your RSS count to be equal to or less than your Storehouse protection capacity. Extra resources will be permanently wiped out upon moving.

* Forgetting the 30-Day Cooldown: Standard migration triggers a strict 30-day global cooldown before you can migrate again.

* Unbinding Alliance Before Stocking: Leaving your alliance before requesting officers to restock passport pages in the Alliance Shop blocks your ability to purchase them.

guides.title: Spending Guide
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: Maximize your budget across the current KvK theater! This quick guide breaks down how to get a permanent 10% bonus via the Lilith Store, the exact recharge events to wait for, and a priority ranking of the best-value bundles to buy so you can focus entirely on rare gems, sculptures, and equipment.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
Spending guide

DISCLAIMER: this video is focused on spending money on a game, this is not financial advice, we are not financial advisors, please Maintain a verified baseline of the money to spare, this is a mobile game after all.

Spending is a huge part of Rise of Kingdoms, and with sleepers out of the way, it makes us crave all the juicy bundles even more. But what are the best ways to actually use your money?

The best way to spend your money is actually not in the game, but in the Lilith Store. You can access this via the ingame Icon Called ‘’rok club’’ you will be directed to the lilith store where you will be guided towards many different types of flux you can buy.

The nice thing about it is since you are using their stores, lilith dont need to pay google or apple, so they give you extra 10% coins on your purchases, a win win, every 10 coins is roughly 1$, the more expensive the bundle is, the less value coins have, so it is better to use em on lower value bundles like 3$ dailies or 5$.

You cannot get these coins by just paying ingame, that is why you basically lose more money by paying in the actual game.

.

You can always spend money in the game, but when are the best times?

The first time is when the recharge event comes around, there are many versions of the event with different levels of rewards and tiers, but spending on them is always the highest value.

This is one of the best times to spend in the game because you get extra rewards for something you would have bought anyway.

Another time you can spend, is the road to greatness or gem rush event which usually comes around holidays aswell. This is a spending event where you need to recharge for 1000-12000 gems. This will give specific sculptures, so choose your commander carefully. You will only have a limited amount of commanders you can choose from.

There are 5 different levels.

The last big one is the bounty of the ancients that arrive as an event when you start your kvk. This is a very good and worthy event where you can recharge up to 25k gems. It is important to know that these usually give equipment choice chests and a lot of speedups, only a few sculptures can be gained from this, that is why the number 1 time to spend is definitely when the recharge event is up.

Another time to invest is the commander recharge event which lasts 5 days where you have to recharge 1000 gems a day to get specific commander sculptures, so remember to choose wisely. This event is probably one of the worst, but if you are in a hurry to spend, then rather go for this event than no event at all.

Best value:

Here we have some of the best value bundles, it is very important to spend on the right thing, so here is a decent order of most worthy bundles.

- The lucern scroll events will give some of the most worthy rewards in the game, you will be met by city skins and equipment which are the highest priority to spending. 5$.

- Growth fund is another brilliant way to get a massive income in gems, the value is 2000% which is the biggest value percentage in the game. 15$.

- 30 day gem supply. First purchase 5$, after 30 days then you can buy again for 10$. Very good value because of so many gems.

- Writer of history because of it’s huge gold head supply, this bundle is a pop up and is active 5$.

- Vanquisher is another pop up bundle coming which gives 4 equipment choice chests with a few gems aswell, it’s a 5$ bundle and very worth it.

- Daily special offer, one of the best things to invest in if you have a few bucks laying around. Watch out, you need to focus on which commander you choose. 2.99$ ( if we compare value/$ daily bundle is the best bundle in the game, you can watch chisguel video for the detailed breakdown )

- Minamoto VIP bundles, this is like a hidden feature but getting Minamoto’s 2nd skill to 5 will give you 1h discount on every building upgrade you do, for 60 days it will save you almost as much as you would get from a maxed 3GC bundle. 2 ways to do it if you dont plan to max mina,

Minamoto 1511: 8$ VIP Packs 1, 2, 3, 4 \= 50 Heads

- Aim for 1511, if you don't get it, reset and try again.

If you have money to spare ( not recommended if spending less than 250/month )

- Minamoto 5511: 44$ VIP Bundles 1 Through 7

Here is an overview of all the pop up bundles within the early game:

- Mistakes are made daily, but they can be prevented. The usual mistakes are to spend on getting resources and speedups, but you can make them easily in the usual events and daily tasks you do. That is why you should focus on not spending on bundles giving resources or speedups, however, Gems, equipment and sculptures are some of the rarest things to get your hands on, so you have to think before buying.

- Another mistake to avoid, is spending on buying raw gems, it is not anywhere near as worth it as buying a gem supply or the growth fund.

General info:

- Spending is not about getting the most resources or speedups, but it is actually about getting the rare things like gems, legendary equipment and sculptures. The reason to not get resources and speedups, is actually because you will get them in the game from just doing daily things like doing normal events. Legendary equipment, sculptures and all the rare things are way harder to get.

- Focus in this order: gems, sculptures, equipment. These 3 focus points are the most valuable things when spending.

If you want more detailed advice and breakdown for what you should spend your money on from month 1-3 of your account, from 30$ a month to 2500$ a month, join the new era server, and have access to all spending guides, and other general guides. And we will be available to answer any questions, so just contact us and we will be happy to help !!

guides.title: Ultimate High Spender Spending Guide
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: Build battlefield dominance across multiple meta marches while keeping your spending lean and effective! ⚡ The definitive High Spender tactical blueprint for Rise of Kingdoms.  This guide details how high spenders can achieve full-account versatility—dominating Open Field, Rally, and Garrison roles—without slipping into wasteful, redundant purchases. Learn how to systematically build multiple elite equipment sets with Iconic investments, push VIP levels aggressively, and max out essential Crystal Tech before major KvK war phases. Discover how to stack recharge and seasonal events so every single purchase drives maximum permanent progress!
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
The Ultimate High Spender Spending Guide

Spend Aggressively. Build Dominance. Stay Efficient:

A High Spender has enough spending power to build a highly competitive account and maintain multiple strong marches.

Unlike a Whale, however, you should still care about where your money goes.

The objective is to create a complete, powerful account without crossing into unnecessary Whale/Kraken-level spending.

Daily & Bundle Purchases:

Buy Daily:

• Daily Special Offers for meta commanders

• Gem Supply

• Material Supply

• Crystal Supply during KvK

• VIP Shop Speedups

• VIP Shop Materials

• VIP Shop Blueprints

Priority Bundles:

• Writer of History

• King's Coronation

• Living Legend

• Geared Up

• Vanquisher

• Call of the Ancients

• Recharge Events

• Holiday & Anniversary Bundles

• Crystal Bundles

• Zenith Preparation Bundles

• High-value event bundles

At this spending level, you can begin purchasing multiple bundles during important events.

However, don't automatically buy every bundle.

Main Rule:

Buy aggressively when the value is high.

Stop when the value becomes poor.

Commanders & Equipment:

High Spenders should be building a serious multi-march account.

Commander Priority:

Open Field → Rally → Garrison → Secondary/Niche

Build several meta marches instead of putting everything into one commander.

Expertise the commanders that directly improve your role.

Keep enough Legendary Sculptures for upcoming meta releases.

Equipment:

Equipment should become one of your biggest investments.

Prioritize:

• Material Bundles

• Blueprint Bundles

guides.content_markdown:
The Ultimate Low Spender Spending Guide

Spend Less. Progress More:

A Low Spender is a player who spends a small amount of money but wants to get as much progression as possible from every purchase.

You cannot afford to buy everything, so efficiency is everything.

Your goal should be to build a strong account without wasting money on low-value bundles.

Daily & Bundle Purchases:

Highest Priority

Buy Daily:

• Gem Supply

• Material Supply when available

• Crystal Supply during KvK

• VIP Shop items when they are highly valuable

Best Bundles

Prioritize:

• Writer of History

• King's Coronation

• Recharge Events

• Holiday & Anniversary Events

• High-value Crystal Bundles during KvK

Do not buy every bundle.

Avoid spending simply because you have a limited-time offer available.

General Rule

If a purchase doesn't significantly improve your account, save your money.

Commanders & Equipment:

Low Spenders should be extremely selective with Legendary Sculptures.

Commander Priority:

- Your main Open Field commander

- Your second main march

- Important meta commanders

- Rally/Garrison commanders only if your kingdom needs you in that role

- Never spread sculptures across too many commanders.

- Save sculptures for commanders that will remain relevant.

Equipment:

Equipment is one of the best long-term investments for a Low Spender.

Focus on:

• Free equipment events

• Egg Event when you have enough gems

• Holy Knight's Treasure

• Equipment materials from events

• Blueprint selection chests

Finish one strong set before starting another.

A finished strong march is better than five unfinished marches.

Gems & VIP:

Your gems need to create permanent account value.

- Gem Priority

- More Than Gems

- VIP Points

- Wheel of Fortune

- Egg Event

- Castle Books

- VIP Shop

- Your biggest long-term goal should be reaching VIP 12 → VIP 14 efficiently.

- Do not waste gems on unnecessary resources or speedups.

More Than Gems

Save your gems specifically for More Than Gems whenever possible.

This is one of the best opportunities for a Low Spender to turn saved gems into permanent progression.

KvK Priorities:

KvK should be your biggest spending period.

Every KvK

• Buy Crystal Supply

• Complete important Crystal Technology

• Use events to obtain additional speedups/resources

• Save resources for fighting

• Prioritize healing and training when needed

Do not spend heavily on crystals outside of KvK unless there is a very good reason.

Your Goal

Stay useful throughout the entire KvK rather than becoming strong for one battle and running out of resources.

Events & Final Tips:

Prioritize

• More Than Gems

• Egg Event

• Wheel of Fortune

• Recharge Events

• Anniversary Events

• Seasonal Events

• KvK Crystal Events

Remember

- Never chase rankings you cannot realistically win.

- Save gems for high-value events.

- Save Legendary Sculptures.

- Finish your strongest march first.

- Use free events to build equipment.

- Don't buy resources unless absolutely necessary.

- Avoid impulse purchases.

A great Low Spender isn't the player who spends the most.

It's the player who gets the most account progression from every dollar.

guides.title: VIP Shop Purchase Priority — Tactical Dossier
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: * VIP Level Scaling: Higher VIP levels unlock superior items and deeper resource discounts. Key benchmarks include VIP 6 (2nd building queue & baseline speedups), VIP 10 (Universal Legendary Sculptures), and VIP 13+(Deeper material & speedup deals).
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

* Weekly Reset Cycle: The VIP Shop refreshes every Sunday at 00:00 UTC. All stock caps, discounts, and item allocations reset completely, allowing you to re-purchase high-value items.

* VIP Level Scaling: Higher VIP levels unlock superior items and deeper resource discounts. Key benchmarks include VIP 6 (2nd building queue & baseline speedups), VIP 10 (Universal Legendary Sculptures), and VIP 13+(Deeper material & speedup deals).

* Currency Rule: F2P and low-spend players must strictly differentiate between buying items using Food/Wood/Ore versus Gems. Spending gems on non-essential VIP shop items starves your MTG (More Than Gems) and Wheel stockpiles.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

* Resource-to-Item Buying Routine: Buy 100% of available discounted speedups and materials offered for Food, Wood, or Ore every single week without exception. Resources are infinitely renewable via farm accounts, making these purchases pure free value.

* Gem Protection Protocol: Treat your gem balance with total restraint. Never spend gems in the VIP Shop on regular days; reserve gem purchases exclusively for high-yield MTG events or emergency material/speedup needs during active KvK wars.

* Pre-War Material Stockpiling: Prioritize buying Blueprint Chests and Equipment Material Chests with excess resources in the weeks leading up to KvK to craft key commander gear pieces.

STRICT AVOID

Massive waste of gems. Resources can be farmed and Silver/Gold Stars come passively from keys/events.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

* MTG Optimization via Materials: If you need to hit the 7,000 or 25,000 gem threshold during More Than Gems and already have excess VIP points, buy Legendary Equipment Materials or Blueprint Chests in the VIP Shop to convert gems directly into endgame march stats.

* VIP Level Progression Milestones: Pushing your VIP level itself directly improves the VIP Shop's offerings. Prioritize pushing VIP 10, 12, and 14 first before evaluating high-tier gem purchases in the store.

* Speedup Hoarding for Power Events: Convert idle city food/wood production into 8-hour and 60-minute training/building speedups weekly. Stockpiling these over 2–3 months guarantees top placement in events like Game of Power.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

* Buying Raw Resources with Gems: Never purchase Food, Wood, Stone, or Gold tokens using gems under any circumstances; this is the worst gem-to-value conversion rate in the game.

* Purchasing Golden Keys with Gems: Avoid spending gems on Golden Chest Keys in the VIP Shop. Golden Keys yield low legendary sculpture rates compared to Wheel of Fortune or MTG pushes.

* Skipping Resource Purchases to Save Food: Do not skip resource-cost speedups out of fear of running out of food or wood. Send farm marches out for a few hours to replenish raw resources rather than forfeiting weekly speedup stocks.

guides.title: Armaments And Inscriptions — Tactical Dossier
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: Unlock State Forum for Armament system. Match formations to troop type (Wedge for skill damage, Arch/Hollow Square for tank). Prioritize Inscribed Epics with active inscriptions over plain Legendaries. Farm KvK for Transmutation Scrolls and Inscription materials.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
🛡️ ARMAMENTS AND INSCRIPTIONS GUIDE

## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

- State Forum Unlock: Unlock the State Forum in your city to access the Armament system, clear travel stories, and unlock formation slots for your marches.

- Formation Synergy: Match specific Formations (such as Arch, Wedge, or Hollow Square) to your army type to gain base stat bonuses and enable matching Armament slots.

- Armament Rarity Tiers: Prioritize Legendary (Gold) and Inscribed Epic (Purple) Armaments, as they grant superior base attributes and special Inscription effects.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

- State Forum Travel Stories: Complete daily State Forum Travel Stories to earn Autograph Transcripts, targeted Armament chests, and Formation materials.

- Targeted Attribute Allocation: Equip Armaments with attributes that directly match your march's main damage type (e.g., Infantry Health/Defense, Cavalry Attack/Speed, Archer Skill Damage).

- Inscription Slot Priority: Focus on securing Inscriptions that grant direct march-wide combat buffs, active rage gain, or damage reduction during open-field KvK battles.

- Transmutation Scroll Usage: Save Transmutation Scrolls to reroll secondary attributes on Legendary Armaments that already possess high base stat values or active Inscriptions.

- Recycling Unused Armaments: Recycle unwanted Green, Blue, and duplicate Purple Armaments into State Forum coins to purchase targeted chests in the Forum Shop.

- Shop Refresh Routine: Buy discounted Transmutation Scrolls, Inscription materials, and targeted Armament chests from the State Forum Shop every weekly refresh.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Inscribed Armament Preference: Prioritize equipping an Epic Armament with a powerful active Inscription over a plain Legendary Armament with bad attribute rolls.

- March-Specific Formations: Use Wedge Formation for skill-damage-heavy commanders (like YSG or Nevsky) and Arch/Hollow Square for high-survivability field marches.

- KvK Inscription Farming: Participate actively in KvK events and Lost Kingdom achievements to farm rare Inscription materials and high-tier Armament choice chests.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Equipping Mismatched Stats: Avoid equipping Armaments with attributes that do not benefit your active march (e.g., Archer Attack attributes on an Infantry march).

- Rerolling Low-Tier Armaments: Never waste rare Transmutation Scrolls or materials on Blue or un-inscribed Epic Armaments; save them strictly for top-tier Legendary pieces.

- Neglecting Formation Upgrades: Do not leave your active Formations underleveled, as higher formation levels significantly amplify the base stat gains of all equipped Armaments.

guides.title: Crafting Materials Optimization
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: 4:1 combine ratio across Iron, Leather, Bone, Ebony. Keep queues running 24/7, shift production to match your main march's needs, and buy 50-80% discounted chests from Courier Station. Dismantle unused gear for 100% material refund — never combine everything to Gold prematurely.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
🛡️ CRAFTING MATERIALS OPTIMIZATION GUIDE

## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

- Material Tier Combining Ratio: Upgrading materials requires combining 4 identical items of the same tier to produce 1 item of the next higher tier.

- The Four Core Materials: All forged gear consumes varying amounts of Iron Ore, Leather, Animal Bone, and Ebony.

- Continuous Blacksmith Production: Keep your Blacksmith queues continuously producing base materials 24/7 without allowing idle gaps.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

- Balancing Production Queues: Produce materials evenly across all four types early on, then shift production to match the heavy material needs of your main march.

- Targeted Material Conversion: Avoid combining raw materials to Legendary quality prematurely; keep items at Elite (Blue) or Epic (Purple) tier until you are ready to forge.

- Inventory Material Storage: Keep material choice chests saved in your inventory as chests until you need specific materials to finish a blueprint.

- Courier Station Resource Deals: Purchase material choice chests from the Courier Station (Merchant) whenever available at a 50% to 80% discount using wood or food.

- Dismantling Low-Tier Equipment: Dismantle unused Normal or Advanced equipment to retrieve 100% of the invested crafting materials back into your inventory.

- Lucerne Scrolls Material Supply: Complete daily and weekly Lucerne Scrolls tasks to secure consistent high-tier material choice chests throughout the season.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Strategic Material Crating: Open Material Choice Chests exclusively to balance shortages of your primary march’s rarest material requirement.

- Event Stacking for Materials: Focus on events like "Geared Up" or "Hammer and Anvil" to claim bonus material chests while spinning for blueprints.

- Disassembling Refined Pieces: Disassembling refined Epic items allows you to reclaim base materials to immediately reallocate into secondary march builds.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Combining Everything to Gold: Do not combine all lower-tier materials into Legendary (Gold) quality immediately, as doing so locks them out of crafting essential Epic gear.

- Uneven Material Hoarding: Avoid over-producing a single material type (like Iron Ore) while neglecting secondary inputs like Bone or Ebony.

- Idle Blacksmith Production: Never allow the Blacksmith production queue to sit empty, as lost crafting time permanently delays gear progression.

guides.title: Dismantling & Refining — Tactical Dossier
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: Dismantle refunds 100% materials but destroys blueprint. Refine Legendary Weapons/Chests first for +30% stat multiplier at max. Epic + Special Talent (+30%) often beats unrefined Gold. Crit-fish cheap Blue gear for budget marches. Never refine off-meta Gold gear.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
🛡️ DISMANTLING & REFINING GUIDE

## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

- Dismantling Yield Ratio: Dismantling equipment refunds 100% of the crafting materials invested, but completely destroys the gear piece and forfeits the original blueprint.

- Refining Mechanics: Refining legendary equipment requires duplicate blueprint fragments and additional materials to advance refinement progress, granting up to a +30% stat multiplier at max refinement.

- Special Talent Crit Value: Striking a Special Talent crit during initial forging or refinement grants a permanent 30% stat increase to that specific gear piece, making crit fishing a core endgame strategy.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

- Dismantling Transition Threshold: Dismantle early Blue and White gear the moment you are ready to craft refined Epic (Purple) replacements, instantly recycling 100% of your raw materials.

- Refining Priority Order: Focus refinement resources strictly on high-base-stat Legendary pieces (Weapons and Chest pieces) before attempting to refine lower-yield accessory or boot slots.

- Pity System Accumulation: Every failed refinement attempt builds progress toward a guaranteed Special Talent crit threshold, ensuring steady account progression over time.

- Epic vs Legendary Math: A fully refined Epic (Purple) gear piece with Special Talent active (+30% stats) frequently rivals or beats a unrefined, un-critted basic Legendary (Gold) piece at a fraction of the material cost.

- Blueprint Reclamation Constraints: Never dismantle Legendary equipment unless you are completely replacing it in your main march, as the blueprint used to forge it cannot be recovered upon dismantling.

- Gold Recycling Routine: Keep a reserve of gold currency saved for major refinement pushes, as higher refinement tiers consume millions of gold per attempt alongside materials.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Crit Fishing Low-Tier Gear: Repeatedly forge and dismantle cheap Blue or Green gear pieces until you trigger a Special Talent crit to maximize budget march performance for minimal material waste.

- Dismantling Refined Duplicates: If you forge an un-critted Legendary piece and later craft a critted version, dismantle the extra un-critted duplicate to recycle 100% of its base materials.

- KvK Combat Readiness: Prioritize securing a full set of refined Epic gear across your primary KvK marches before attempting to refine single Legendary pieces for a secondary march.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Dismantling Unique Blueprints: Avoid dismantling limited event-exclusive or hard-to-farm Legendary gear pieces unless you have excess blueprint copies in reserve.

- Refining Off-Meta Gear: Never spend precious Legendary blueprints or materials refining non-optimal or obsolete Legendary gear; save refinements strictly for Best-in-Slot (BiS) endgame gear.

- Premature Legendary Refining: Do not attempt to refine Legendary gear until your primary march is fully equipped with at least baseline Legendary pieces across every single slot.

## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

- Blueprint Fragment Collection: Legendary (Gold) equipment requires 30 matching blueprint fragments to craft a single complete item, making targeted fragment farming essential for gear progression.

- Sunset Canyon Daily Runs: Fight your maximum free attempts daily in Sunset Canyon and Lost Canyon to accumulate Canyon Coins and earn randomized equipment blueprint chests.

- Shop Currency Accumulation: Save specialized shop currencies—such as Canyon Coins, Osiris Coins, and KvK Conquest Coins—specifically for high-value blueprint fragment drops rather than consumable items.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

- Canyon Shop Rotation: Check the Canyon Shop weekly to purchase guaranteed legendary blueprint fragments (such as Eternal Night or Shio's Return pieces) using your accumulated Canyon Coins.

- Hammer and Anvil Event: Save your gem stashes and equipment hammers for the "Hammer and Anvil" (Egg Event) to reliably target full legendary blueprints or choice chests.

- Hammer Event Milestone Strategy: Spin the Hammer and Anvil event to key milestone tiers (such as 10, 25, or 45 spins) to claim guaranteed extra blueprint fragment choice chests.

- Vip Shop Weekly Buys: Purchase discounted equipment material chests and blueprint fragments from the VIP Shop using resources to steadily build fragment stacks over time.

- Osiris League Shop Priority: Spend Osiris Coins earned from Ark of Osiris matches on rare legendary blueprint fragments that are unavailable in standard daily shops.

- KvK Achievement Farming: Complete all Lost Kingdom achievements and personal honor milestones during KvK seasons to claim high-tier legendary equipment choice chests.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Targeted Blueprint Choice Chests: Save generic "Legendary Blueprint Choice Chests" in your inventory until you have enough fragments to immediately finish a specific piece for your primary march.

- Holy Site Guard Farming: Defeat level-appropriate Holy Site guardians and specialized map bosses during kingdom events to earn bonus equipment blueprint fragment drops.

- Baron and Title Stacking: Request the Judge title or temporary kingdom combat buffs before entering high-tier PvE events that reward blueprint drops based on clear times.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Spreading Blueprint Choice Chests: Avoid opening blueprint choice chests to pick pieces for multiple different marches; focus 100% of your choices on completing one set at a time.

- Buying Random Shop Items: Never waste Canyon Coins or Osiris Coins on basic speedups, resources, or silver keys when legendary blueprint fragments are available.

- Spinning Egg Event Off-Milestone: Avoid stopping your spins between major milestone tiers in the Hammer and Anvil event, as you miss out on free threshold bonus chests.

guides.summary:
Valheon Strategic Dossier: F2P GEAR PROGRESSION MAP GUIDE
F2P GEAR PROGRESSION MAP GUIDE
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
🛡️ F2P GEAR PROGRESSION MAP GUIDE

F2P GEAR PROGRESSION MAP GUIDE

## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

- Equipment Forge Unlocks: Unlock the Forge as soon as possible to start producing materials daily; consistent material production is the primary bottleneck for gear progression.

- Stat Priority Rule: Prioritize Health and Defense stats over Attack stats when forging gear, as Health and Defense significantly increase open-field march trades and survivability.

- White and Green Starter Sets: Craft basic White and Green quality gear early on for your main march slots; these low-cost items provide immediate stat boosts for minimal material costs.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

- Infantry Progression Path: Transition from basic gear into Blue items like Gatekeeper's Shield and Staff of the Sun, moving toward a full Epic set featuring Sakura Light armor and Karuak's Humility.

- Cavalry Progression Path: Rush Heart of the Saint and Vanguard Set pieces early, progressing toward Heart of the Pit, Dark Lord's Cloak, and Wind Scars for optimal speed and attack stats.

- Archer Progression Path: Build Delane's Amulet and Revival Set pieces, scaling into Epic items like Golden Age bow, Seth's Brutality, and Dragon's Breath gear.

- Special Talent Crit Optimization: Dismantle and craft low-tier Blue gear until you hit Special Talent crits before moving up to Purple gear to secure an extra 3% bonus stat boost per piece.

- Material Production Routine: Keep all blacksmith queues producing Iron, Leather, Ebony, and Bone continuously 24/7 without letting material slots sit empty.

- Blue Blueprint Conservation: Save excess Blue and Purple blueprints; use lower-tier gear as temporary placeholders instead of rushing unrefined high-cost items.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Sunset Canyon Blueprint Farming: Fight daily in Sunset Canyon and Lost Canyon to secure guaranteed equipment chests and rare blueprint fragments.

- Hammer and Anvil Events: Save material chest openings and major forging projects for specialized equipment events to earn extra bonus material rewards.

- Refinement Strategy: Fully refine your core Epic (Purple) set before attempting to forge Legendary (Gold) pieces, as refined Epic gear often outperforms unrefined Legendary gear for a fraction of the cost.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Rushing Unrefined Legendary Gear: Avoid crafting low-tier or unrefined Legendary (Gold) equipment early; the massive material cost will leave your main march far weaker than a full refined Purple set.

- Prioritizing Attack Stats: Do not craft gear pieces that offer pure Attack stats at the expense of Health or Defense, as Attack scales poorly in large open-field KvK engagements.

- Dismantling Advanced Materials: Never dismantle high-tier materials or waste blueprints on secondary gathering commanders until your primary combat march is fully equipped.

guides.title: Iconic Equipment Awakening — Tactical Dossier
guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: Maximize your Legendary gear stats with Iconic Crystals. Learn the optimal slot priority (Boots → Weapon → Helmet/Chest → Accessories), Tier 4 milestone for Damage to All Troops buffs, and why awakening beats refining for guaranteed returns. Farm crystals via KvK milestones and Osiris League.
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
🛡️ ICONIC EQUIPMENT AWAKENING GUIDE

## ⚙️ Core System Mechanics & Quantitative Baseline

- Iconic Awakening Concept: Iconic Awakening consumes Iconic Crystals to grant permanent base stat increases (Health, Defense, Attack) and troop damage buffs to eligible Legendary equipment pieces.

- Crystal Resource Bottleneck: Iconic Crystals are rare endgame materials obtained through KvK rewards, Osiris League, and high-tier events; spending them efficiently on high-yield slots is vital.

- Base Stat Scaling: Iconic Awakening adds flat base stats to gear items, which scale far more effectively on high-base stat items like Weapons and Helmets than on accessory slots.

## 📋 Valheon Tactical Execution Protocol

- Baseline Tier Spread: Awaken all equipped Legendary pieces to Iconic Tier 1 or 2 first to gain massive initial stat returns per crystal spent before pushing individual pieces to higher tiers.

- Priority Slot Sequencing: Target slot priorities strictly in order: Boots (for high-yield slots like Infantry), Weapons, Helmets/Chests, and finally Accessories and secondary slots.

- Iconic Tier 4 Milestone: Push key pieces offering "Damage to All Troops" buffs to Iconic Tier 4 to maximize raw damage output on primary open-field marches.

- Boots Slot Efficiency: Non-Cavalry boots (especially Infantry boots) yield some of the highest stat-to-crystal ratios at Tier 5, making them a top candidate for high-tier awakening.

- Refining vs Awakening: Prioritize Iconic Awakening over expensive Legendary gear refining, as awakening guarantees exact stat gains without wasting blueprint fragments or materials.

- KvK Event Stacking: Complete all seasonal KvK achievements and Lost Kingdom milestones to accumulate maximum free Iconic Crystals before executing major awakening pushes.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Weapon First Focus: Awaken your primary march’s Legendary Weapon immediately, as it provides the largest single-slot offensive stat improvement in the game.

- Base Stat Matching: Align your awakening investments with commanders that leverage high natural Defense and Health stats to maximize the value of flat Iconic additions.

- March Specialization: Maximize the Iconic levels of a single primary combat march before spreading crystals across secondary or farm-hunting marches.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Spreading Crystals Evenly: Avoid leveling every item across multiple marches to low iconic tiers; concentrate crystals to max out your primary KvK war march first.

- Awakening Low-Tier Gear: Never attempt to spend Iconic Crystals on Epic (Purple) gear; save all crystals exclusively for endgame Legendary (Gold) equipment.

- Ignoring Slot Priorities: Do not dump high-tier crystals into accessories early, as their iconic stat yields per crystal spent are far lower than core armor slots.

guides.summary: Valheon Strategic Dossier: Stop letting material bottlenecks stall your equipment progression and ruin your trading efficiency! ⚒️ The ultimate material optimization roadmap for Rise of Kingdoms.  This guide breaks down exact material targets before KvK 1 across every spending tier—from 100 legendary materials for F2P players up to 800 for top Krakens. Master essential milestones like rushing City Hall 16 for the Blacksmith and reaching VIP 14–18 for production boosts, Sunset Canyon ticket limits, and daily purple chests. Learn how to maximize daily routines, time gem events like the Egg and Hammer events, and pick high-value bundles so you can forge high-tier gear faster!
guides.author: Valheon Strategic Intelligence
guides.content_markdown:
Materials guide

How to maximize your material income:

Ch 16 quick for blacksmith, this is for a way better income in total and can end up getting you many extra mats.

VIP 14 goal, VIP 14 gives a 5% production boost on materials. It also gets access to max amount of sunset canyon tickets (VIP 13 to be precise).

Reach daily 100 points every day, it can end up giving you up to 8 legendary materials before kvk 1.

Important information to know:

- you unlock blacksmith when your city hall is level 16.

VIP material production speed per %:

VIP 14 \= 5%

VIP 16 \= 10%

sunset tickets per VIP:

vip 1-4 \= 2 attacks.

Vip 5-6 \= 3 attacks.

Vip 7-8 \= 4 attacks.

Vip 9-10 \= 5 attacks.

Vip 11-12 \= 6 attacks.

Vip 13-SVIP \= 7 attacks.

1 by daily 100 points.

VIP 18 \= 1 purple material choice chest per day

F2P material guide:

There are many different ways to gather materials into your account, but we have to think about time, events, and any add ons. It is always important to complete any event that gives materials to get the best income before your first kvk.

Overview:

- Daily/weekly income: 100 point daily, blacksmith daily, sunset canyon daily. (VIP shop weekly)

- Events: sunset, 7k gem, AMOB, Ceroli, Realm of mystique, mercantile melee, shadow legion.

Overall amount of legendary materials before kvk 1: 50-100 (calculation \= 99,5)

(note: hammer event is worth it for free hammers)

- Events: sunset, 7k gem, AMOB, Ceroli, Realm of mystique, mercantile melee, shadow legion.

The ultimate equipment guide

equipment is a crucial part of the battlefield, being the key to success on the Battlefield, choosing equipment is important. But it is more important to choose the right type.
